about: A SNAPSHOT of the public KiwiSDR receiver directory (kiwisdr.com/public). A receiver in this list is NOT known to work now: availability changes, some receivers limit connection time or users, and some need a password. Use the checks in the Receiver Manager and respect each receiver owner's rules.
source: KiwiSDR.com public receiver directory, via http://rx.linkfanel.net/kiwisdr_com.js
selection: all active receivers in Japan + the best (by reported SNR) per country; excluded: https-only, bare IP addresses; port 8073 is assumed when the directory shows none (port_assumed)
